'''''Anacamptis collina''''', the '''fan-lipped orchid''',<ref>{{Cite web |title=Anacamptis collina (Fan-Lipped Orchid) |url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/ORCH/Anacamptis_collina.php |access-date=30 October 2023 |website=MaltaWildPlants.com}}</ref> is a species of [[orchid]]. It is native to the [[Mediterranean]] and [[Caspian Sea]] regions, from [[Portugal]] and [[Morocco]] to [[Iran]] and [[Turkmenistan]].<ref name="tabby">[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=8570 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]</ref>
